scope: Reachability of the giver and receiver of every Torden conversation mission considered by migration TordenConversationMissions (research/20260926-torden-missions), and the hold of 936 The Results Are In
method: Rasa.NavMesh --path <map>.nav x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2 (the same Detour FindPath query the server runs; docs/navmesh.md), run in mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:5.0 against the repository's navmesh/ files. Start points are the client's own uimapmarker waypoint, hospital or map-label positions (research/20260926-torden-missions/work/markers.json, decoded from uimapmarker.pyo); end points are the NPC positions in the deployed rasaworld.db (sha256 f0142463b3f850772c3466955487af4fdac58048c87d19a6ac846dfeecf273b5), which the new migration does not move.
limits: The navmesh is derived by Recast from the client's map geometry (climb 0.9 m, slope 50 degrees); it is the standard the world audits use (WorldPositionAuditTests), not a capture of what a final-live player could reach. A player can jump or slide where the mesh has no link, so 'unreachable' means 'not connected on the walkable surface the server and its audits model'.
